items.title: Is Arista Networks Stock As Expensive As It Looks?
items.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) stock trades at 58.3 times its last twelve months of adjusted earnings, which add back stock-based pay after tax. That is a high price for one year of profit, and it is why the stock looks expensive. The picture changes against the profit forecast for this year and next.
